security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown code fences, inline code, or relative frontend API examples rather than executable Ruby shell backticks. Two npx shadcn@latest instructions are confirmed medium risk because they execute a remotely resolved package CLI.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the shadcn CLI version and require user confirmation before running npx or npm package commands.
Mark shell commands as optional manual steps and avoid auto-running package installation during agent workflows.

content.value_statement: Frontend fixes often lose project conventions and workspace safety. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Unite-Hub React UI work.
actual_capabilities: Guides React 19 and Next.js 16 App Router frontend changes.
Defines shadcn/ui component usage and customization rules.
Adds or updates dashboard routes, navigation, and breadcrumbs.
Requires workspace filters for Supabase-backed UI data.
Covers loading, error, accessibility, and responsive design states.
Documents local visual testing with the development server.
limitations: It is tailored to the Unite-Hub project structure and naming.
It does not design backend APIs or database schemas.
Visual accuracy still depends on running the app and inspecting screens.
It excludes advanced animations, theme builders, and drag-and-drop for V1.

use_cases.title: Fix dashboard UI bugs
use_cases.description: Repair layout, state, and navigation issues while preserving Unite-Hub design tokens.

use_cases.title: Translate product UI requests
use_cases.description: Turn a page request or design note into a responsive Next.js route.

use_cases.title: Improve data-safe screens
use_cases.description: Add workspace filtering and clear loading states to customer-facing dashboard views.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a simple layout issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused UI repair.
prompt_templates.prompt: Fix the dashboard layout issue on [page]. Preserve Unite-Hub design tokens, responsive behavior, and shadcn/ui conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a dashboard page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a new route.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new dashboard page for [feature]. Add navigation, breadcrumbs, loading states, and responsive layout using existing Unite-Hub patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Implement an interactive workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the [component] workflow. Add handlers, API calls, toast feedback, error states, and accessibility behavior without changing unrelated files.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a frontend feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for safety and UX review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [feature] for workspace filtering, responsive behavior, loading states, accessibility, and shadcn/ui consistency. Then fix confirmed issues.

output_examples.input: Add an analytics page to the dashboard.
output_examples.output: Creates a dashboard route plan, updates navigation, defines responsive sections, and notes required breadcrumbs and visual checks.

output_examples.input: Fix the Hot Leads send email button.
output_examples.output: Identifies the component, adds the click workflow, calls the email endpoint, and reports success and error states.
Finds contact queries, adds workspace filtering where missing, and explains the tested data isolation behavior.

best_practices: Read existing components and design tokens before creating new UI.
Filter all workspace-owned data before rendering dashboard content.
Test mobile, tablet, desktop, dark theme, keyboard flow, and error states.
anti_patterns: Do not use generic shadcn defaults without Unite-Hub customization.
Do not show shared data without a workspace filter.
Do not leave buttons, dialogs, or API failures without user feedback.

faq.question: What projects is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for Unite-Hub frontend work using React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.

faq.question: Can it create new dashboard routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes route creation, navigation updates, breadcrumbs, and page structure for dashboard features.

faq.question: Does it cover backend implementation?
faq.answer: No. It consumes API endpoints and Supabase queries, but it does not define backend architecture.

faq.question: How does it handle workspace safety?
faq.answer: It requires workspace filters on relevant Supabase queries before user data is displayed.

faq.question: Does it support accessibility work?
faq.answer: Yes. It calls for ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus states, and screen reader behavior.

faq.question: Should agents run package commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. Package installation commands should require user confirmation and pinned versions when possible.
